// diagnostic E0212

Jet.OwnerMovedWhileViewed

An owner is moved, replaced, or resized while a live view still points into it.

What

An owner is moved, replaced, or resized while a live view still points into it.

Why

The operation could move or destroy the storage that the view reads or edits; Jet rejects before lowering instead of relying on a backend borrow error.

Fix

Finish using the view before changing the owner, narrow the view's scope, or make an owned copy.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.OwnerMovedWhileViewed: Tests/UI/caret_range_write_window_list_param.stderr.

Error: Jet.OwnerMovedWhileViewed: A range write window can't fill a list parameter that may resize
  --> Tests/UI/caret_range_write_window_list_param.jet:7:16
    |
  7 |     grow_twice(values[1..2])
    |                ^^^^^^
 Why: A range window has a fixed length, but this function may grow or shrink the list it receives through its write parameter
 Fix: Pass the whole list: `fill(values)`
